items.prompt: Wulan buys items that cost Rp18.750, Rp32.400 and Rp9.480. Round each price to the nearest Rp1.000, then add. What is her estimate in rupiah?
hints: Round each price on its own first.
Look at the hundreds digit of each price.
items.explanation: Rp18.750 rounds up to Rp19.000, Rp32.400 rounds down to Rp32.000 and Rp9.480 rounds down to Rp9.000. The total is Rp60.000.

items.prompt: Which of these numbers does NOT round to 3.5 when rounded to 1 decimal place?
hints: Look at the hundredths digit each time.
A digit of 5 or more makes the tenths digit go up by one.
Check each one: which rounds to 3.4 or 3.6 instead?
items.explanation: 3.55 has a hundredths digit of 5, so it rounds up to 3.6. The other three all round to 3.5.

options.why: The hundredths digit is 5, so it rounds up to 3.5.
The hundredths digit is 6, so it rounds up to 3.5.
The hundredths digit is 4, so it rounds down to 3.5.

items.prompt: A rectangular field is 48.7 m long and 31.2 m wide. Round each length to the nearest 10 m, then multiply. What is the estimated area in square metres?
hints: 48.7 is closest to 50, and 31.2 is closest to 30.
items.explanation: 48.7 rounds to 50 and 31.2 rounds to 30. 50 × 30 = 1,500 square metres.
